usedFor: anny runs your bookings; HubSpot tracks the revenue. A “New Booking” in anny can run “Create Deal” in HubSpot, so every reservation or appointment shows up in your pipeline.

bestTemplate.name: “New Confirmed Booking” in anny, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed booking is accepted business, so deals only appear for bookings you actually honor, not every request.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” fires whenever a booking changes, so wiring it to “Create Deal” can create several deals for one booking. Keep “Create Deal” on one-time events like “New Booking”.
